motion_rule: he rides a runaway parcel trolley racing at the lens down a sorting hall, the camera racing backwards ahead so the racks tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; the trolley carries him through every beat and he never works a prop standing; head half the frame, closer from 8.3; new shot size each beat; camera move every beat
character: a bristling brown hedgehog in clerk's sleeve garters, deadpan
second_characters: ONE mole stamp clerk in a green visor swinging along the racks beside him, slapping a fresh stamp on the tin every single time it is shut
props: ONE stiff cancellation card on a chain round his neck, punched with one round hole; ONE steel tin riding the trolley
prop_continuity: it is the same card on the same chain all clip and it is whole every time he checks it, until it goes at 8.3; the mole's stamps pile up on the tin lid and never come off
environment: a packed parcel sorting hall, racks of parcels to the ceiling both sides, the trolley racing under him
light_events: hard noon sun through the roof lights bars his face every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.0 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: TRI RA-za, pe-re-pro-VE-ril, ot-me-NIL, o-NO sa-MO, pro-dle-VA-et
audio.pacing: 0.5-3.4 one breath; the gap under one second; 4.35-7.5 one breath with no voice sound outside the lines; he says each line once and never says a line twice; after 7.5 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: the trolley rattling, the hall roaring, a lid slam and a stamp thud at 3.4, the same at 6.15, a dry crumble at 8.3, a chain clink at 9.1

timeline.a: the card swings into the lens on its chain, whole, as he rides the trolley, racks tearing past
he holds the card up to the lens without slowing, the hall streaking behind
he flips the card over on the move and it is whole on both sides
he drops the card in the tin and slams the lid as the trolley hauls him on
the mole swings in off the racks and slaps a fresh stamp on the shut lid
he cracks the tin at full speed and the card is whole, and he shows it to the lens
he slams the lid again and the mole stamps it again, the racks tearing past
he drives the trolley at the lens with the tin under his arm, stamps piling on the lid
he rips the tin open one last time and holds the whole card into the lens
the card crumbles to dust in his paws at the lens and the dust blows off down the hall
an identical card drops onto the empty chain, already stamped, and swings at his chest
he throws himself into the lens, deadpan, the new card swinging whole at his chest

must_appear: one and the same card on the chain; it is whole at 1.2, whole at 4.35 and whole at 7.5; at 8.3 that same card crumbles to dust in his paws in full view; at 9.1 an identical stamped card drops onto the empty chain; at 9.5 his deadpan face is in the lens
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a second card before 9.1, the card torn or damaged before 8.3, a line said twice, a word not in the lines, a drawn-out word, a parked camera, a still background, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
